encoding: gzip; empty filename; mtime0; compression level9
producer_manifest_rule: The producer manifest refers to semantic analysis.json. Decompress the exact stored Git object and verify these original bytes and hash before evaluating that manifest. No producer artifact or metric is rewritten.
reconstruction_procedure: Read and verify the SHA-256 of the canonical Git gzip object.
Gzip-decompress it without text decoding or newline conversion.
Verify uncompressed byte count and SHA-256 against this index.
Use those exact bytes as the producer semantic analysis.json for producer-manifest checks and JSON analysis.

storage_limit_reference.claim: Regular GitHub repositories block individual files larger than 100 MiB.
